title: Coast Guard rescues 2 from vessel taking on water near Año Nuevo Island
description: A Coast Guard Air Station San Francisco MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew rescued two people from a 57-foot Chris-craft taking on water approximately 3 miles off of Año Nuevo Island, California, April 18, 2019. The Dolphin crew hoisted two people into the helicopter and had to make an emergency landing at a parking lot in Santa Cruz due to low fuel, where emergency medical services met the crew. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
